title: Sister Tharpe and the Panoram film at the Savoy
summary: Working the Savoy with Lucky, Sister Rosetta Tharpe joins the band, and he appears in a Panoram film short for $15.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So that's when I started working at

the Savoy with Lucky, and right after I joined the band, Sister Thärpe came with us -- she had just left the Cotton Club with Cab Calloway, and she joined us, I guess, well, I think that Moe Gale had her signed up at the time, and so he put her with the band.

She was singing the gospel music with a jazz band, and we -- made the Panorama, remember when President Roosevelt's son had this thing, it was like the forerunner of TV -- you put a dime in and you saw a picture of the band and the music and the dancers and all this ...
Yeah, yeah -- was that Roosevelt's son?

Yeah, Roosevelt was head of that out in California, and they used me to open these things -- I don't know if anyone remembers, but if they remember, when you put the dime in, you saw this guy, you saw a closeup of this guy beating on the drums and smiling, and they faded back and faded back until there wasn't any more of him, and that was me -- and then the name of the song and the orchestra came on.
